title: Nichole Air: Amazon Island
description:
You’re flying in first class on Nichole Air. Lucky you.
Soon, you’ll be visiting Amazon Island…  losing yourself on the warm beach, breathing in the sweet, aphrodisiac smell of exotic flowers. The thoughts of the towering, beautiful women guide your steps deeper into the jungle… until you find the tallest, strongest, most gorgeous woman in the world.

She’ll take you back with her… for pleasure, for devotion, and for the sacred breeding ritual.
author: Goddess Nichole
